description: The ManyWells dataset card describes synthetic gas, oil and water production from simulated vertical wells. Three collections vary stationary or changing boundaries and open-loop or closed-loop control, with accompanying well configurations. The provider is Solution Seeker AS. Coverage: Each collection is described as 2,000 synthetic wells with 500 observations per well. These are simulated cases, without real geographic coverage or an observational calendar. Access: The provider publishes a Hugging Face dataset card and programmatic access instructions. Only the page and its metadata were read. Licence and cost: The provider states Creative Commons BY-NC 4.0. The noncommercial condition limits reuse. Limitations: The samples inherit the simulator’s assumptions. Well identifiers are unique within each collection only; simulated values do not establish field accuracy. For simulation it offers labelled benchmarks for flow surrogates, calibration and control methods. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
